svg.title: Three Workloads, Three API Paths
svg.desc: Three Brindle Travel workloads mapped to API paths: itinerary chat streams, receipt photos use an image content block, and overnight re-pricing uses the batch path, with a cached prefix marked on the shared prompt.
svg.text: Brindle Travel: pick the path from who is waiting and what the input is.
